rows.title: The Job Tracker list's Résumé column showed '—' for a job linked to a résumé that was since deleted, as if it had never been linked, while the job page says 'Résumé deleted'
rows.summary: Now: a job whose linked résumé was deleted reads 'Résumé deleted' in the list's Résumé column, the same as on the job page. A job never linked still shows '—', and a linked job still shows the résumé's name. src/components/job/ListView.jsx uses the same linkedResume(job, resumes) helper from src/utils/jobQuery.js as the job page (J-21), instead of its own resumes.find.

rows.title: Importing a file whose entries named neither a company nor a role (another tracker's 'companyName'/'jobTitle' export, or a list of empty objects) added one blank 'Untitled Company' card per entry and reported them as imported
rows.summary: Now: an imported entry with no company and no role is left out, because the job form will not save such an entry either. A file of only such entries says 'No job applications found in that file.' and adds nothing, so importing it again does not pile up blank cards. A mixed file imports the named jobs and shows the partial-import warning ('Imported N job applications; what could not be read ...'). The check is in mergeImport (src/utils/jobMerge.js): an entry that is not named is skipped and marks the import lossy.
rows.remaining: Entries from another tracker's format ('companyName'/'jobTitle') are dropped, not mapped. Mapping foreign field names would be a separate feature.

rows.title: A job moved to the wrong status by mistake (a card dropped on the wrong board column, 'Move to', a click on the job page's stepper or status menu) had no Undo, and moving it back by hand left a false history entry and an applied date, so the Summary kept counting it at that step
rows.summary: Now: every status move on the board (drag or 'Move to') shows a toast such as 'Acme moved to Offer' with an Undo button. A move on the job page's Application Stage stepper or its status menu shows 'Moved to Offer' with Undo. Undo puts back the status and the status history. It also clears an applied date that the move filled in, unless the user has changed that date since. Other edits made since the move stay. Undo does nothing if the job has moved on since, and it is ignored after the list has left the browser (sign-out). The Summary's funnel and applied count no longer count the job at that step. How it works: the store in src/hooks/useJobStore.js has changeStatus(id, status), which returns the change, and undoStatus(change). They use the new pure helper undoStatusChange in src/utils/jobEdits.js. src/pages/JobTracker.jsx and src/pages/JobDetail.jsx now call them. docs/knowledge/07-job-tracker.md is updated.
